# The TI CC2340 on the SimpleLink Low Power F3 SDK. The SDK is not vendored: SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT
# names an installation, and its licence allows its use with TI's parts only. The radio is
# only reachable through the SDK's Radio Control Layer, whose configuration, the CCFG block and
# the drivers' setup are generated by TI's SysConfig from a firmware's .syscfg file, so a
# firmware brings one and add_sysconfig() runs the tool on it.
if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    if (NOT DEFINED SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Please define SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT to point to your SimpleLink Low Power F3 SDK installation!")
    endif()

    # SysConfig's command line tool: given, or the newest of a Code Composer Studio installation
    if (NOT DEFINED SYSCONFIG_TOOL)
        file(GLOB candidates /Applications/ti/ccs*/ccs/utils/sysconfig_*/sysconfig_cli.sh $ENV{HOME}/ti/sysconfig_*/sysconfig_cli.sh)
        list(SORT candidates)
        list(LENGTH candidates count)

        if (count EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Please define SYSCONFIG_TOOL to point to SysConfig's sysconfig_cli.sh!")
        endif()

        list(GET candidates -1 SYSCONFIG_TOOL)
    endif()

    # in the cache, since add_sysconfig() runs in the firmware's directory
    set(SYSCONFIG_TOOL ${SYSCONFIG_TOOL} CACHE FILEPATH "SysConfig's command line tool, sysconfig_cli.sh")
    message("SYSCONFIG_TOOL: ${SYSCONFIG_TOOL}")

    # The part's directory of the SDK: CC2340R5 -> cc23x0r5, CC2340R2 -> cc23x0r2
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^CC2340(R[0-9]).*" "cc23x0\\1" part_dir ${BLUETOE_BINDING})
    string(TOLOWER ${part_dir} part_dir)
    set(part_dir ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/source/ti/devices/${part_dir})
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^CC2340(R[0-9]).*" "cc23x0\\1" part_name ${BLUETOE_BINDING})
    string(TOLOWER ${part_name} part_name)

    # hardware specific options for every target that needs them: the SDK's headers, as
    # system headers since the SDK's warnings are not ours, and the device family the SDK's
    # headers are selected by
    add_library(toolchain_cc23x0 INTERFACE)
    add_library(toolchain::cc23x0 ALIAS toolchain_cc23x0)
    target_include_directories(toolchain_cc23x0 SYSTEM INTERFACE
        ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/source
        ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/kernel/nortos
        ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/kernel/nortos/posix)
    target_compile_definitions(toolchain_cc23x0 INTERFACE DeviceFamily_${BLUETOE_BINDING}=1 DeviceFamily_CC23X0R5)

    # The SDK's code a firmware on this platform links, compiled from the SDK's sources: the
    # Radio Control Layer, the radio's BLE5 firmware images, the drivers the radio and the
    # rig need, the no-RTOS kernel with its interrupt, clock and power layer, and driverlib.
    # The SDK's prebuilt libraries are LTO bytecode of the GCC they were built with and link
    # with no other; the sources compile with any. Their warnings are the SDK's, not ours.
    enable_language(ASM)

    set(rcl_dir ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/source/ti/drivers/rcl)
    set(drivers_dir ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/source/ti/drivers)
    set(nortos_dir ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/kernel/nortos)

    file(GLOB driverlib_sources ${part_dir}/driverlib/*.c)

    add_library(sdk_code_cc23x0 STATIC
        ${driverlib_sources}
        ${part_dir}/driverlib/aes_gcc.s
        ${part_dir}/rf_patches/lrf_pbe_binary_ble5_${part_name}.c
        ${part_dir}/rf_patches/lrf_mce_binary_ble5_${part_name}.c
        ${part_dir}/rf_patches/lrf_rfe_binary_ble5_${part_name}.c
        ${rcl_dir}/LRF.c
        ${rcl_dir}/RCL.c
        ${rcl_dir}/RCL_Buffer.c
        ${rcl_dir}/RCL_Debug.c
        ${rcl_dir}/RCL_Gpio.c
        ${rcl_dir}/RCL_Profiling.c
        ${rcl_dir}/RCL_Scheduler.c
        ${rcl_dir}/RCL_Feature.c
        ${rcl_dir}/hal/RCLLPF3_Hal.c
        ${rcl_dir}/lrf/LRFLPF3.c
        ${rcl_dir}/lrf/LRFLPF3_FIFO.c
        ${rcl_dir}/lrf/LRFLPF3_Interface_Generic.c
        ${rcl_dir}/handlers/ble5.c
        ${rcl_dir}/handlers/generic.c
        ${drivers_dir}/power/PowerCC23X0.c
        ${drivers_dir}/GPIO.c
        ${drivers_dir}/gpio/GPIOLPF3.c
        ${drivers_dir}/Temperature.c
        ${drivers_dir}/temperature/TemperatureLPF3.c
        ${drivers_dir}/batterymonitor/BatteryMonitorLPF3.c
        ${drivers_dir}/batterymonitor/BatMonSupportLPF3.c
        ${drivers_dir}/utils/List.c
        ${drivers_dir}/utils/Math.c
        ${drivers_dir}/utils/Random.c
        ${nortos_dir}/NoRTOS.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/posix_sleep.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/DebugP_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/MutexP_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/SemaphoreP_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/SwiP_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/SystemP_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/ClockPLPF3_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/TimestampPLPF3_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/QueueP_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/HwiPCC23X0_nortos.c
        ${nortos_dir}/dpl/PowerCC23X0_nortos.c)
    target_link_libraries(sdk_code_cc23x0 PUBLIC toolchain::cc23x0)
    target_compile_options(sdk_code_cc23x0 PRIVATE -w)

    # what a firmware links: the SDK's code, and libgcc for the divisions the M0+ has no
    # instruction for
    add_library(sdk_cc23x0 INTERFACE)
    add_library(sdk::cc23x0 ALIAS sdk_cc23x0)
    target_link_libraries(sdk_cc23x0 INTERFACE sdk_code_cc23x0 -lgcc)

    # the SDK's startup code: the vector table, the trims, .data and .bss, then main()
    add_library(startup_cc23x0 OBJECT ${part_dir}/startup_files/startup_gcc.c)
    target_link_libraries(startup_cc23x0 PRIVATE toolchain::cc23x0)
    add_library(startup::cc23x0 ALIAS startup_cc23x0)

    # the SDK's linker script: the part's flash and RAM and the CCFG block at its address
    set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY BLUETOE_LINKER_SCRIPT ${part_dir}/linker_files/${part_name}.lds)

    # The CCFG block carries checksums over its parts, patched into the linked image by
    # ccfg_crc.py, what the SDK's crc_tool does; the part locks its debug port on an invalid
    # block, so no image leaves here without.
    function(add_linker_script target)
        get_property(script GLOBAL PROPERTY BLUETOE_LINKER_SCRIPT)

        set_property(
            TARGET ${target}
            APPEND
            PROPERTY
                INTERFACE_LINK_DEPENDS ${script})

        target_link_options(${target}
            PRIVATE -T ${script})

        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND python3 ${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/ccfg_crc.py $<TARGET_FILE:${target}> ti_utils_build_GenMap_sym_CRC
            VERBATIM)
    endfunction()

    # SysConfig on the firmware's .syscfg: the radio's PHY configuration, the CCFG block and the
    # drivers' setup as generated sources of the firmware, regenerated when the script changes
    function(add_sysconfig target syscfg)
        set(out ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}_sysconfig)
        set(generated
            ${out}/ti_radio_config.c
            ${out}/ti_radio_config.h
            ${out}/ti_drivers_config.c
            ${out}/ti_drivers_config.h
            ${out}/ti_devices_config.c)

        add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${generated}
            COMMAND ${SYSCONFIG_TOOL}
                --product ${SIMPLELINK_SDK_ROOT}/.metadata/product.json
                --compiler gcc
                --board /ti/boards/${BLUETOE_BOARD}
                --output ${out}
                ${syscfg}
            DEPENDS ${syscfg}
            COMMENT "SysConfig for ${target}"
            VERBATIM)

        target_sources(${target} PRIVATE ${generated})
        target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE ${out})
    endfunction()

    # J-Link programs the hex, which holds the CCFG block beside the application
    if (DEFINED BLUETOE_JLINK)
        message( WARNING "J-Link ${BLUETOE_JLINK} selected")
        set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY BLUETOE_SELECT_JLINK_DEVICE -USB ${BLUETOE_JLINK})
    endif()

    function(define_flash_command target)
        get_property(select_jlink_device GLOBAL PROPERTY BLUETOE_SELECT_JLINK_DEVICE)

        file(GENERATE OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.jlink CONTENT
"si SWD
speed 4000
connect
loadfile ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.hex
r
g
exit
")

        add_custom_target(${target}.flash
            COMMAND JLinkExe -Device ${BLUETOE_BINDING} -If SWD -Speed 4000 ${select_jlink_device} -CommandFile ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.jlink
            VERBATIM
            )
        add_dependencies(${target}.flash ${target}.artifacts)
    endfunction()

else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Please set CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE to one of the tool-chain files in platforms/cmake!")
endif()
